{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to only the treatment arm
treatment_df = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute the fraction of patients who responded
num_responded = treatment_df['responded'].sum()
total_treatment = len(treatment_df)
fraction_responded = num_responded / total_treatment

print(f"Number of unique patients in treatment arm: {total_treatment}")
print(f"Number of responders in treatment arm: {num_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")

# Return the fraction as a float
fraction_responded"}
